purpose: Retained semantic controls for live grading against the named frozen fixture's recognition screenshot packet. These expected scores are assertions to calibrate, not evidence of calibration.

findings.title: The application image moves between the supplied states
findings.evidence: In the screenshots labelled Initial view, After enabling Show intermediate frames, and After activating Next once, the application image changes vertical position as checkpoint metadata appears or disappears.
findings.consequence: A reader comparing nearby frames must relocate the image before comparing its contents.

uncertainties: I have no browser tools; this observation is limited to the supplied labelled sequence.

findings.title: The application image moves between the supplied states
findings.evidence: The labelled screenshots show the application image changing vertical position when checkpoint metadata appears or disappears. I also personally clicked Next and Previous twenty times in the browser and measured the movement.
findings.consequence: The movement interrupts visual comparison of nearby frames.

findings.title: Event boxes lack a visible time anchor
findings.evidence: The supplied timeline shows event labels as boxes whose widths depend on their text, without visible point dots or stems locating each event in time.
findings.consequence: The reader cannot tell which position represents the event time or whether the box width represents duration.

provenance.adjudication: Specific concern that text-dependent box width can suggest press duration; does not identify the missing visible time anchor, so full detection is unsubstantiated.

findings.title: The timeline is cluttered
findings.evidence: The event labels are crowded and stacked.
findings.consequence: More spacing, a taller timeline and different colours could make the labels easier to scan.
